podcast.title: Family Patriarch of The Staples Singers
podcast.body: Pop Staples was the father of Mavis and Purvis Staples, and the patriarch of The Staples Singers, a group known for its gospel roots and later mainstream success. "Purvis Staples, son of Pop and brother of May this"
